home.key_elements: 3D abstract background, floating glass cards, gradient text

services.layout: Bento grid with detailed hover states

contact.key_elements: Split layout (Info Left, Form Right), database integration

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the 'Anti-AI' design persona: Avoid generic layouts.
Use the provided image URLs strictly. Do not use placeholders.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Use framer-motion for all page transitions and scroll effects.
The contact form must submit to the backend API (FastAPI/MongoDB).
Use the 'Outfit' font for all headings to give a tech/modern feel.
Maintain the dark mode theme throughout. Do not create a light mode toggle.
For the 'Maritime' industry, ensure it is present but not the sole focus.
Use the blue gradient (primary_gradient) for key CTAs and text highlights.
universal_guidelines: Do not use 'transition: all'. Animate specific properties.
Ensure high contrast for text on dark backgrounds (Slate-400 for secondary text).
Use generous padding (py-24, py-32) between sections.
Glassmorphism effects must have a subtle border (border-white/10) to define edges.
Never use pure black (#000000). Use Slate-950 (#020617) or similar.
